class.name: NNNQSSearchSpaces
class.brief_description: Base class for Node Query System (NQS) search spaces that supply candidate nodes to filter and score.
class.description: Defines the set of candidate nodes evaluated by an NQS query (such as nodes in a group, children of a node, overlapping areas, or a generated 2D/3D point grid). Add [NNNQSSearchCriteria] children beneath a search space to filter and score its candidates. Run queries asynchronously via [NNNodeQuerySystem] (recommended, or via [NNBTRunNQSQuery] / [NNNQSQuerySensor]), or directly with [method execute_query]. When finished, [signal query_completed] is emitted and [member query_results] and [member query_result_scores] hold up to [member top_n_to_find] winning nodes sorted highest score first.

method.name: execute_query
method.description: Runs or resumes the query directly up to [param time_budget_usec] microseconds ([code]0[/code] runs to completion). Returns [code]true[/code] when finished, or [code]false[/code] if more calls are needed. Prefer [method NNNodeQuerySystem.post_query] for automatic frame budgeting.

method.name: get_debug_scored_nodes
method.description: Debug builds only. Returns all surviving candidate nodes from the last completed query when watched via [method watch_debug_scores].

method.name: get_debug_scored_scores
method.description: Debug builds only. Returns the scores matching [method get_debug_scored_nodes].

method.name: initialize_search_space
method.description: Initializes the search space (such as building point grids or connecting area signals). Called automatically in [method Node._ready]; call manually if a script overrides [method Node._ready].

method.name: unwatch_debug_scores
method.description: Debug builds only. Releases one [method watch_debug_scores] watcher and clears debug score snapshots when the last watcher leaves.

method.name: watch_debug_scores
method.description: Debug builds only. Records scores for all surviving candidates on query completion (used by NQS debug visualizers). Match with [method unwatch_debug_scores].

signal.name: query_completed
signal.description: Emitted when the query finishes, with [member query_results] and [member query_result_scores] populated.
